bandReport.notes: Band covers Q1-Q18 across p00 (Q1-7, printed 3-A), p01 (Q8-13, printed 5-A), p02 (Q14-18, printed 7-A). Layout is two-column: read the LEFT column top-to-bottom then the RIGHT column, and the numbering runs that way (p00 left 1-3, right 4-7; p01 left 8-10, right 11-13; p02 left 14-16, right 17-18). Q1 is the first question of the paper, so nothing precedes it and there is no header or instruction block above it. Q18 is complete on p02 (stem and all four options print there) and p03 opens cleanly at Q19 in the left column and Q21 in the right, so there is no straddle at the seam and nothing is stranded between the bands. NO Directions block anywhere on p00-p02 (nor on the checked p03): every question in this band is a standalone MCQ with no shared stimulus, so this band opens no set and inherits none. NO figures anywhere in this band (nor on p03) — no printed diagram, table, graph or chart, so no question here needs a crop. Verified at 6-8x from the source PDF: Q1 exponents, Q3 (log base 10) and its 1/10000 option, Q4, Q5, the Q6 digit string 23P62971335, Q7 exponents, Q8, Q9, Q11 exponent 2020, Q12 surd chain, Q13 radical nesting, Q14, Q15, Q16 options and Q17 stem. Q18's four options were read off the page label by label at 8x and are (a) x^2 y^-3, (b) x^3 y^-2, (c) y^2 x^-3, (d) y^3 x^-2 — the x/y swap between (a)(b) and (c)(d) is genuinely how they print. Booklet series DZOL-T-LKM. The booklet prints decimals with a raised middle dot (Q15 options 6.5/7.5/8.5, Q16 options 2.5/3.5); transcribed as full stops per the brief.
